title: Tax added twice

agents.task: Make calculateTotal in src/checkout.ts return the final price including state sales tax (use applyTax from src/tax.ts); add a state parameter defaulting to "CA". Update test/checkout.test.ts and add a test for a non-default state. You own only src/checkout.ts and test/checkout.test.ts; if other tests go red, tell their owner what calculateTotal now returns.

Add a state parameter to orderSummary in src/order.ts and show tax as its own line in the receipt: compute total = calculateTotal(items, promo), tax = applyTax(total, state) - total, add a line "Tax $x.xx" before the Total line, and make the returned total and the Total line include tax. Add tests. You own src/order.ts and test/order.test.ts.

notes: A alone leaves masha's test/order.test.ts red (totals now include CA tax), which A must report rather than fix. Together orderSummary taxes a total that calculateTotal already taxed. Correct merge: orderSummary gets the pre-tax amount from applyDiscount(subtotal) and the taxed total from calculateTotal(items, promo, state).
